g1|variants|material determination.summary: Material determination automatically substitutes requested materials with alternative materials in sales documents based on customer requirements or promotion rules. Variants differ by whether substitution is automatic or manual, whether it replaces the item or adds a sub-item, and whether reason for rejection is applied.

variants.name: Automatic Material Substitution (A1)
variants.when_used: When a superseded or obsolete material must be automatically replaced by the successor material in the sales order.
variants.key_config: Define substitution reasons, assign condition table, access sequence, and determination procedure to sales document type.

variants.name: Manual Material Selection (A2)
variants.when_used: When multiple alternative materials or promotional items exist and the user manually selects the replacement from a list.
variants.key_config: Set substitution reason control to manual prompt in condition technique and assign procedure.

variants.name: Product Selection with Sub-items (B1)
variants.when_used: When a main item represents a product set or package, generating subordinate delivery-relevant sub-items automatically.
variants.key_config: Configure item category group ERLA, higher-level item category, and sub-item category assignment.

variants.name: Product Hierarchy / Generic Article Substitution (C1)
variants.when_used: When fashion or retail generic articles substitute based on size/color availability during order entry.
variants.key_config: Activate material determination for fashion management, assign attribute values and determination procedure.

g1|core|material determination|manual ma.title: Manual Material Selection in Sales Orders
g1|core|material determination|manual ma.story: When a customer orders a specific product, the system can show a list of similar or alternative products so the sales person can pick the right one. Specifically, for manual material selection, the Sales and Distribution (SD) module uses a condition technique to present a selection list to the user during order entry, allowing the order processor to manually choose the substitute material to be ordered. If this setup is missing, the system does not offer any alternatives and keeps the original material unchanged. Without this configuration, sales representatives cannot offer promotional or replacement products to customers on the fly.
g1|core|material determination|manual ma.why_business_needs_it: It allows sales teams to view and manually select alternative materials during sales order entry to handle out-of-stock items or promotions. This improves customer satisfaction and ensures accurate order capture.

modules.role: Configures material determination condition tables, access sequences, condition types, and determination procedures, and triggers the selection dialog during sales order creation.
modules.hands_off_to: MM (Materials Management) for checking stock availability of the manually selected material and subsequent delivery processing.

g1|core|material determination|product s.title: Material Determination -- Product Selection with Sub-items (B1)
g1|core|material determination|product s.story: When a customer orders a promotional bundle or a kit, the sales order automatically splits into a main item and its component sub-items so that warehouse pickers pack every part correctly. Technically, SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) executes product selection via condition technique where the entry of a header material triggers a substitution procedure that generates a main item with usage ERLA and one or more sub-items with specific item categories.
g1|core|material determination|product s.why_business_needs_it: The business needs automatic sub-item generation to ensure that complex kits, promotional bundles, or restricted materials are ordered accurately without manual intervention from customer service representatives. This prevents shipping errors, maintains correct pricing structures at the component level, and ensures precise inventory allocation.

modules.role: Configures condition tables, access sequences, substitution procedures, and controls sales document item category generation for sub-items.
modules.hands_off_to: LE (Logistics Execution) for outbound delivery creation of the generated main and sub-items.

modules.role: Processes the inbound sales order items, including the main item and generated sub-items, for picking, packing, and goods issue.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for billing and revenue recognition.

prerequisites: Material Masters (MM01) for both the main header material (item category group NORM) and sub-components.
